summary: Final how-we-win report written to /Users/imyu/Desktop/cloude/competitive-analysis-2026-06.md (TL;DR, what-changed, 10-row moat table, 6 battle cards, honest gaps, 7 prioritized moves, positioning check). VERDICT: execution-coupled memory is verified unoccupied at code level — nobody (Mem0, Graphiti/Zep, Letta, Cognee, claude-mem, any orchestrator, or native CC) produces memory from task completion, invalidates deterministically with provenance, or routes context via typed edges under a token budget; Mem0 even deleted graph memory from OSS. Durable core narrows to bi-temporal execution-coupled graph + metric/judge/optimize loop + local-neutral daemon (12-18+ mo native ETAs); cross-session aggregation and two-tier handoff are on a 3-12 mo subsumption clock (CLAUDE_CODE_TASK_LIST_ID, Dreaming). The category claim hangs on two proof points: bench v4 (context-REQUIRED tasks; today lift is unproven — cost parity, v5 ON did 1.29x MORE work, winnable slice ~23%) and wiring context-gate.js into the daemon (currently offline prototype). Runner graveyard (Vibe Kanban/Terragon/Crystal all dead H1 2026) confirms: position as the intelligence layer feeding fleets, never a runner UI. Darwin framing holds with amendments (substrate clock + Beads watch); final positioning sentence proposed in §7, attached as knowledge. item.title: Moat verdict: execution-coupled memory is verified unoccupied
item.value: Code-level audit of all competitors (Mem0, Graphiti/Zep, Letta, Cognee, claude-mem, Vibe Kanban, Claude Squad, Conductor, claude-flow, Beads, Cursor, Agent HQ) confirms NOBODY couples memory to task execution: none produces memory from task completion, invalidates via deterministic supersession/judge/benchmark events with provenance, or routes context via typed edges under a token budget. Mem0 deleted graph memory from OSS (~4000 lines) — the mindshare leader is retreating from graphs. The durable core (per substrate analysis): bi-temporal execution-coupled graph (overlay.js:222-262) + metric/judge/optimize loop (measure.js/optimize.js, native ETA 12-18+ mo) + local-neutral daemon posture.

item.title: The two gating proof points: bench v4 lift + live context gate
item.value: The entire 'verifiable self-improvement' category claim hangs on two unfinished items: (1) bench v4 — tasks where context is REQUIRED — must convert the n=2 held-out existence proof (cold 0/10 & 0/8 vs warm 8.75/10 & 8/8, zero variance) into a frequency/lift result; today aggregate ON-vs-OFF is cost parity (1.03x) and v5 showed ON doing 1.29x MORE work on easy tasks, winnable slice ~23%. (2) lib/context-gate.js is offline-only (regret 0, ~690k tok-eq avoided) — daemon.js does not import it; it must be wired into the live inject path, difficulty-gated per v5's lesson (forced retrieval on easy tasks is net-negative).

item.title: Substrate clock: Anthropic subsumption is 6-18 mo on two of three pillars
item.value: Darwin's 'Agent Teams = substrate not competitor' framing holds but needs a clock: Dreaming (dreams API, research preview) + 'self-learning agents' as stated Anthropic roadmap erode the memory-consolidation half in ~6-12 mo; CLAUDE_CODE_TASK_LIST_ID makes cross-session aggregation one default-flip from subsumed (3-6 mo, highest risk pillar); two-tier handoff is a cheap native add (6-12 mo). NOT subsumed at 12-18+ mo: bi-temporal graph semantics wired to execution, the metric/judge/benchmark optimize loop (liability-shaped for a substrate vendor), cross-workspace ghost edges, local-neutral daemon. Execute the delete-and-ride list: freeze router smarts, loop pacing/budget plumbing, generic agent-isolation worktrees (keep only measure→merge worktrees). New urgent risk: cleanupPeriodDays sweep now GCs ~/.claude/tasks/ — snapshot native fields at completion.

item.title: Runner-layer graveyard: position as intelligence layer feeding fleets
item.value: Empirical 2026 pattern: Vibe Kanban (shut down 2026-04-10, 'couldn't find a business model'), Terragon (dead 2026-01-16), Crystal (deprecated Feb 2026) — three polished parallel-runner UIs died in two quarters while Agent HQ/Cursor 3 commoditize the runner layer from above. Conclusion: never compete as a runner UI. Darwin is the intelligence layer that feeds well-scoped, context-rich tasks (summary tier attached) to whatever fleet executes — consider setting CLAUDE_CODE_TASK_LIST_ID for orchestrated jobs to ride native sync. Threat watch: Letta Code (git Context Repositories shipped Feb 2026, fastest convergence), claude-mem (65k+ stars, owns 'Claude Code memory' mindshare), Beads/Gas Town (only honest knowledge+work-graph fusion attempt, no bi-temporality/learning/tiered handoff).

item.title: Final positioning sentence (supersedes June 10 Darwin note phrasing)
item.value: Long form: 'Darwin is the self-learning memory layer for agent fleets: the work graph IS the memory graph — every completed task leaves knowledge with receipts (what it superseded, why, what it cost), every future task inherits exactly what it needs under a token budget, and we publish the benchmarks — including the negative ones — that show precisely when that memory pays.' Short form (memory-vendor kill line only, not full positioning): 'Their graphs remember what was said; ours remembers what was done — with receipts.' Honesty differentiator to weaponize: publish the held-out memory-win protocol (cold-must-fail-first, held-out graders, published nulls) as a reproducible public benchmark — no vendor publishes nulls; claude-flow (only other measured learning loop) was caught fabricating speedups with Math.random().
